<translate>
<!--T:4-->
'''Yamcha''' is a [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|master]] who lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Yamcha's House|Yamcha's House]] in the deserts of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. He teaches Ki Infusion, three ki attacks and his Wolf Fang strike. He trains anyone, whatever their alignment.
</translate>

<translate>
== Location == <!--T:5-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:6-->
Yamcha lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Yamcha's House|Yamcha's House]], which generates once per world in a desert. Capsule Corp Assistants sell a map to it at trade tier 2 (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Yamcha's House#Finding it|Yamcha's House]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Skills and techniques == <!--T:7-->
</translate>
{{See also|Skills|Techniques}}
<translate>
<!--T:8-->
* '''Skills:''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Infusion|Ki Infusion]]
* '''Ki attacks:''' Spirit Ball, Kamehameha, Ki Barrage
* '''Strike attack:''' Wolf Fang
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:9-->
Everything is paid for with Training Points, and your race has to allow each skill. His '''Train''' option spawns a Shadow Clone to spar with.
</translate>
